qualification.details: Project Assistant: Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture/Horticulture/Allied Sciences/Basic Sciences/Computer Applications or equivalent discipline from a recognized University. Experience: M.Sc./Master's Degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Basic Sciences, Computer Applications or related discipline, along with experience in farmer-oriented field work, ICT/computer applications, data collection, analysis, documentation and agricultural extension activities is desirable. Young Professional I (YP-I): Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture/Horticulture/Forestry/Botany/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Basic or Life Sciences or equivalent discipline from a recognized University with 60% marks/equivalent grade. Experience: M.Sc./Master's Degree in Agriculture/Horticulture/PlantPathology/Botany/Microbiology/Biotechnology or related discipline, with experience in mushroom cultivation, spawn production, agricultural/fibre-waste utilization, laboratory and field work, farmer training, documentation and extension activities is desirable. Field Assistant: Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Science from recognized University. Experience: Preference will be given to local candidates from Tuting area, Upper Siang District having familiarity with the local area, farming communities and field conditions. The selected candidate should stay at Tuting during the project period for smooth implementation of field activities. Experience in field surveys, farmer interaction, data collection, documentation and implementation of agricultural/extension programmes will be desirable.

content_sections.heading: CAU Imphal Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 2 for Project Assistant, 1 for Young Professional I (YP I) and 1 for Field Assistant.

content_sections.heading: CAU Imphal Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Assistant: Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture/Horticulture/Allied Sciences/Basic Sciences/Computer Applications or equivalent discipline from a recognized University. Experience: M.Sc./Master's Degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Basic Sciences, Computer Applications or related discipline, along with experience in farmer-oriented field work, ICT/computer applications, data collection, analysis, documentation and agricultural extension activities is desirable. Young Professional I (YP-I): Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture/Horticulture/Forestry/Botany/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Basic or Life Sciences or equivalent discipline from a recognized University with 60% marks/equivalent grade. Experience: M.Sc./Master's Degree in Agriculture/Horticulture/PlantPathology/Botany/Microbiology/Biotechnology or related discipline, with experience in mushroom cultivation, spawn production, agricultural/fibre-waste utilization, laboratory and field work, farmer training, documentation and extension activities is desirable. Field Assistant: Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Science from recognized University. Experience: Preference will be given to local candidates from Tuting area, Upper Siang District having familiarity with the local area, farming communities and field conditions. The selected candidate should stay at Tuting during the project period for smooth implementation of field activities. Experience in field surveys, farmer interaction, data collection, documentation and implementation of agricultural/extension programmes will be desirable.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CAU Imphal Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in CAU Imphal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the posts of Project Assistant, Young Professional-I, and Field Assistant in CAU Imphal Recruitment 2026. This offers a good opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in CAU Imphal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts available are Project Assistant, Young Professional-I (YP-I), and Field Assistant. Each post has specific eligibility and salary details mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for CAU Imphal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application for CAU Imphal Recruitment 2026 is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified date and venue with their documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for CAU Imphal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for CAU Imphal Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 07 September 2026. Candidates must report at the venue by the specified time.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Assistant in CAU Imphal?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant position at CAU Imphal offers a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month. This is a contractual position under the university.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Field Assistant post, candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Science from a recognized University. Experience in field surveys and local familiarity is desirable.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Conference Hall, College of Agriculture, CAU, Pasighat, Arunachal Pradesh. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age limit for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Field Assistant post, candidates must be below 35 years of age. Age relaxation details, if any, should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring original certificates, one set of self-attested photocopies, an updated biodata/CV, and one recent passport-size photograph to the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions at CAU Imphal is contractual. The duration of the contract will be specified in the official notification or during the interview process.
